managed-grafana-essential-deprecated.title: The Essential Grafana plan is deprecated
managed-grafana-essential-deprecated.body: This estimate uses the Essential plan. Microsoft has deprecated it: new Essential workspaces cannot be created. Standard adds a per-hour compute charge on top of the per-user charge; Microsoft also offers a free Azure-native alternative, Azure Monitor dashboards with Grafana, for teams that only need dashboards.

citation.source: Migrate from Azure Managed Grafana Essential to Standard
citation.quote: The Azure Managed Grafana Essential service tier is deprecated and is scheduled for complete deprecation by March 31, 2027.

more.source: Migrate from Azure Managed Grafana Essential to Standard
more.quote: Migrate to Azure Monitor dashboards with Grafana: Move your dashboards to a free, Azure-native alternative.

managed-grafana-zone-redundancy-choice.title: Zone redundancy can only be chosen at creation
managed-grafana-zone-redundancy-choice.body: This production estimate uses a Standard workspace without zone redundancy. Microsoft states that zone redundancy can be enabled only when the workspace is created, so decide now: it adds an hourly charge per workspace.

citation.source: Enable zone redundancy in Azure Managed Grafana
citation.quote: You can enable zone redundancy only when you create the workspace. You can't change this setting later.
